config.name: meta_gbm-G1short-f4p1
config._doc: research/final/configs/f4_pseudo2025.json with the d <= 1 h segment replaced by the meta member meta-gbm-G1short-f4p1 (research/final/meta/); everything else as the recipe research/final/configs/f4_final.json.

prc-f-x5._note: x5 pinned to xgboost 2.1.4: prc-f-x5-mo/output/oof.csv holds all four folds (M1/M6 from that run, M2/M7 copied from prc-f-x5p-mo; identical values checked). The xgboost 3.4.1 runs were renamed prc-f-x5-xgb341 / prc-f-x5-mo-xgb341 and are not used.

recipe.name: meta_gbm-G1short-f4p1
recipe._doc: f4: f3 with 6-seed c6s (prc-f-c6sm6), c5s (prc-f-c5sm6) and x5 (prc-f-x5m6) and the fs8 c7 refit (prc-f8-c7, 6 seeds) as an extra member of the d <= 1 h and 1-4 h stacks. Segment weights: NNLS on the 2025 month-out predictions of Jan/Feb/Jun/Jul (research/final/pseudo_final.py fit-weights), because fs8 c7 has no A/B OOF; long stack, plog coefficients, overlay, cap, level and post layers as f3, with L1a-v2 loadings refitted on f4's own 2025 pseudo-final rows (research/final/artifacts/daily_v2_f4_loadings.json). Members are refits on the final store: d <= 1 h stack c7 (6 seeds), cs7 (3 seeds), mlp7 (6 seeds); 1-4 h stack c6s (3 seeds), c5s (3 seeds), x5 (3 seeds), c7 (6 seeds). Frozen weights: NNLS on each specification's 2025 A/B OOF (c7's from prc-c7x2, the earlier fs7 bank). x5 is the refit pinned to xgboost 2.1.4. Rows past 4 h: long stack (c6s, c5s, x5, c7) blended with the physical estimate (plog, alpha 1); rows whose AOBT_3 is more than 4 h before takeoff and LIRF rows without AOBT_3 (long.fill = long_stack) take the long stack unblended. Overlay: LIRF rows without ADS-B evidence and d <= 4 h get 0.7 pred + 0.3 k4. Cap pred <= d past 2 h. Level calibration: lam 0.75, cap 0.05, composition offset fitted on the 2025 12-month-out c6 OOF. Post layers: lv_rules with rules 'ad' (NM join window, LEMD/LEBL cap), recovered (L0e), daily (L1a; parameters research/final/levers/artifacts/daily_params.json; L1a-v2 ordinary-row loadings from research/final/levers/artifacts/daily_v2_f2x5_loadings.json), recovered again. Assembler rules: NM join window +-3,631 s, LEMD/LEBL <= 3,604 s, floor 60.
notes: Level calibration: composition offset fitted on the 2025 12-month-out c6 OOF (research/cache/oof_mo12_c6.parquet), lam 0.75, cap 0.05.
Post layers from research/final/levers; see research/final/levers/RESULTS.md.
mlp7: 6 seeds (prc-f-mlp7m6: r2912 from prc-f-mlp7a, r2911/r2913 from prc-f-mlp7c, r2914-r2916 from prc-f-mlp7b).
Segment weights fitted on the 2025 month-out predictions (four months, rows without date-shift artifacts or short-delay y > 3 h); the long stack keeps f3's A/B weights.
L1a-v2 loadings refitted on f4's frozen 2025 pseudo-final rows (col post2_recovered); the 2026 build reads only the fitted artifact.
c6s, c5s and x5: 6 seeds (prc-f-c6s + prc-f-c6sb, prc-f-c5s + prc-f-c5sb, prc-f-x5 + prc-f-x5b; research/final/merge_members.py). fs8 c7: 6 seeds (prc-f8-c7a + prc-f8-c7b).
